_comment: Source images to exclude from curation, keyed by srcHash (the SHA256 of the source file, which is also in data/manifest.json). Keyed by hash rather than cat id on purpose: cat ids are positional and get reassigned every time you recurate, but srcHash is stable forever. Re-run `python tools/curate.py` after editing.

blocked.why: Meme-style image caption burned into the photo, including censored profanity. Not a cat photo so much as a picture of a joke.
